title: Aguadilla airport thermal object
summary: Mick West tells of Aguadilla airport thermal object, about 2013 at Aguadilla, Puerto Rico, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: This is this is over the airport uh at Daguidia, big tourist destination.

2013, I believe in Auadilla, you have this uh in Puerto Rico, you have this uh, you know, 3inute video of a trans medium object, an object that seems to descend into the Atlantic Ocean and then come out as well.
tellings.difference: Michels calls it a transmedium object about 3 minutes long that goes into the Atlantic and comes back out. He gives no thermal or mundane reading.
tellings.link_reason: Same 2013 Aguadilla, Puerto Rico video of an object over the airport area that seems to go into the ocean and come back out.
